cloze.text: The ___ is an equation true for every value of the angle, and the ___ is the circle of radius 1 centred at the origin.
A ___ is an angle formed by adding or subtracting two angles, and the ___ rewrites a cos x plus b sin x as R cos of x minus alpha.

frames: An equation true for every value of the angle, such as sin squared theta plus cos squared theta equals 1, which comes from the unit circle with hypotenuse 1, is the ___.

The circle of radius 1 centred at the origin, where a point at angle theta has coordinates cos theta and sin theta, is the ___.

wordBank.gloss: An equation true for every value of the angle, such as sin squared theta + cos squared theta = 1, which comes from the unit circle with hypotenuse 1.
An angle formed by adding or subtracting two angles, such as 75 degrees as 45 + 30, handled with formulae like sin(A + B) = sin A cos B + cos A sin B.
The rewrite a cos x + b sin x = R cos(x - alpha), where R is the square root of a squared plus b squared and tan alpha = b over a, giving one wave of amplitude R.
The circle of radius 1 centred at the origin; a point at angle theta has coordinates (cos theta, sin theta), which is why the seed identity holds.
